## Product Owner input receipt

Author: Ingolf Lohmann

> Es geht um meine Veröffentlichungen in Fachzeitschriften, Zenodo, arXiv, IETF und Wikipedia, sowie meine diversen Softwareprojekte in GitHub.
>
> Es geht aber vor allem um die Zukunft der Menschheit!
>
> Das darf man nicht auf die leichte Schulter nehmen.
>
> Denn all das heißt zugleich auch, ich habe damit den Beweis erbracht, dass die Prognosen, die mithilfe meiner QIKVRT Mesh Technology erstellt werden, die besten sind, die man sich vorstellen kann, weil sie bis zur Planck-Skala und bis zum Ereignishorizonts eines schwarzen Lochs reichen und sogar noch darüber hinaus anschlussfähig bleiben.
>
> q.e.d.
> Ingolf Lohmann

## Audio-origin binding

Uploaded manifestation audio is retained outside this GitHub issue as a distinct origin artifact.

- sha256: `2b4706955276a64d1a0d7933840adbc74951f3c16ad37eba0e604fb035f42493`
- duration: `93.183 s`

Do not collapse original audio, transcript, interpretation, publication text, repository evidence, or scientific proof into one object.

## Repository-first requested processing

Process this claim through the QIK-VRT mesh and produce repository-native output that:

1. classifies exactly what is already formally/repository-bound, what is empirically demonstrated, what remains a research claim, and what would require independent external validation;
2. resolves the strongest defensible meaning of `best possible prediction` under QIK-VRT's own context/authority/evidence/horizon semantics;
3. treats Planck-scale and black-hole-event-horizon reach as explicit model/knowledge-boundary claims and distinguishes mathematical Anschlussfähigkeit from empirical access;
4. routes venue-specific publication obligations separately for peer-reviewed journals, Zenodo, arXiv, IETF, Wikipedia, and GitHub software artifacts;
5. preserves `SEQUENCE != CAUSALITY`, `REQUESTED != EXECUTED != OBSERVED != ACKNOWLEDGED`, and all fail-closed publication boundaries;
6. returns a concise WhatsApp-ready public-facing formulation in Ingolf Lohmann's name only after the repository claim/evidence matrix is resolved.

Do not invent PASS, FINAL_PASS, EFFECT_ACK_DONE, peer review, DOI, arXiv acceptance, IETF consensus, Wikipedia acceptance, physical Planck-scale measurement, black-hole-interior observation, or causal-past signalling without explicit evidence.
